question: What power is named by calling her skull-staffed great power crossing the world ocean?
premises: This verse names a feminine power by three epithets.
One epithet marks her emblem as a skull staff.
Another marks her as crossing the ocean of worldly existence.
inference: She is named as skull-staffed great power who carries beings across worldly ocean.
plain_english: She is called the skull-staffed great power, the one who crosses the ocean of worldly existence.
